name: Lantern Eater
design: A huge deep-space jaw organism, broad muscular violet-black body under pearly teal biological armor, enormous realistic ridged mandibles, small luminous feeding sacs, convincing exposed gill folds. A menacing premium film creature with full-size mass and believable biological joints. Not a fish illustration and not a spaceship; an original predatory alien adapted to the vacuum. Living luminous organs have depth and translucent membranes, not glowing circles.
parts: TOP LEFT: the broad central body and armored head, mouth faces DOWN, deep dark mouth cavity with fleshy throat, no external mandibles attached. TOP RIGHT: separate powerful LEFT mandible, thick curved chitin, irregular gripping teeth pointing inward, root RIGHT. BOTTOM LEFT: complementary RIGHT mandible, root LEFT, teeth inward, separately correct lighting. BOTTOM RIGHT: a complete small luminous lantern organ with translucent turquoise pearly membrane, dangling curled organic fronds, warm internal seed; isolated object that can drift and be eaten in the game.

Consistent warm upper-left key and cool ambient fill, physically convincing material distinction and depth, detailed but clear when rendered at 250-400 pixels. Deliver ONE SQUARE PNG with GENUINE ALPHA TRANSPARENCY, arranged in four strictly separate 2x2 cells. No text, labels, grid lines, watermarks, concentric glow rings, wire loops, flat geometric stand-ins, cartoon style or plastic. Crisp natural antialiased alpha edges.

name: Scissor Twins
design: TWO distinctly designed but visibly related industrial alien hunter craft that operate as a linked pair. One has a compact hooked aerospace hull with warm ochre painted armor and exposed blue-steel mechanics; the other has a longer forked scarlet hull with titanium ribs and black machinery. Both are gritty maintained full-size spacecraft with recessed engines and believable beveled construction, no LEGO studs, slabs, decorative rings or block-built silhouettes. Functional cutting jaws and deep emitters make their purpose visible. Facing DOWN.
parts: TOP LEFT: the complete LEFT hunter hull, ochre and blue-steel, asymmetric hooked silhouette, no external cutting blade. TOP RIGHT: the complete RIGHT hunter hull, scarlet and titanium, distinctly forked longer silhouette, no external blade. BOTTOM LEFT: separate LEFT structural cutting blade, curved steel scissor jaw with a real hinge housing, root RIGHT, hot narrow cyan cutting edge. BOTTOM RIGHT: complementary RIGHT cutting blade, root LEFT, restrained amber cutting edge. Same consistent scale and orthographic view across the two hunters, genuine materials, each component strictly contained in its atlas cell.

name: Red Wake
design: A vicious needle-shaped comet predator encased in black-red ceramic armor with translucent hot ruby fins and recessed orange plasma organs. Exceptionally narrow and fast-looking, a grown hypersonic organism with tapered interconnected surfaces and organic heat radiators. Meaningful longitudinal anatomy, subtle fissures near extreme heat, black flexible membranes between overlapping blade-like armor. Cinematic realistic materials and strong red identity, not a polished toy fighter, no decorative rings. Faces DOWN.
parts: TOP LEFT: elongated needle core body, extremely narrow rear tail at TOP and piercing armored head at BOTTOM; powerful readable central silhouette without lateral fins. TOP RIGHT: separate LEFT heat vane, long swept translucent dark ruby blade supported by a thin believable black ceramic leading edge, root RIGHT. BOTTOM LEFT: corresponding RIGHT heat vane, root LEFT and matching physically lit material. BOTTOM RIGHT: separate recessed rear plasma vent assembly, elongated open black ceramic housing with orange ember structure inside and a restrained naturally tapered plasma plume pointing UP. No large diffuse halo or background effect.
